state.document: A written order from the army commander to the generals of his army.
state.order: Everything forward! Bevern and Tresckow storm the heights at Křečhoř, cavalry to cover the left.
formations of this army: the Prussian army (General Frederick); also called the King's army, the whole army, the headquarters, my headquarters, the King, the Feldmarschall

Zieten's hussars; also called the hussars
Krosigk's cuirassiers; also called the cuirassiers
Normann's dragoons; also called the dragoons
Frederick's artillery; also called the artillery, the guns

c0_prohib.instructions: Read this part of the order: «Everything forward!». Is it a prohibition or a limit, telling someone what not to do or how far not to go ('do not charge the line without my order', 'not to be drawn beyond X', 'attack nothing', 'only on my express order'), rather than an instruction to do something?

criteria.true: yes, it forbids or limits something
criteria.false: no, it is an instruction to act, or information

c0_forbid.instructions: Read this part of the order: «Everything forward!». If it forbids or limits something, what is forbidden?

criteria.none: nothing in particular is forbidden, or it is not a prohibition
criteria.charge_formed_infantry: not to charge the enemy's formed infantry: his line, his battalions, his squares, the troops on the heights
criteria.attack: not to attack or assault at all, or only on a further order ('attack nothing', 'come into the attack only on my order')
criteria.pursue: not to pursue or follow up a beaten or fleeing enemy
criteria.advance_beyond: not to go beyond or farther than a certain place, not to be drawn off
criteria.engage: not to engage, fight, halt or turn against the enemy, or be drawn into a fight

c0_trig.instructions: Read this part of the order: «Everything forward!». Does it tie what it orders to an event or a time?

criteria.none: no event or time is named: it is to be done at once, or it is a standing rule
criteria.start: it is to be done only when or after something happens or a time comes ('as soon as', 'once', 'when', 'after', 'at <time>')
criteria.until: it is to last only until something happens or a time comes ('until', 'till')

c0_event.instructions: Read this part of the order: «Everything forward!». If it names an event or a time on which what it orders starts or ends, what is that event?

criteria.reached: a formation reaches, takes, holds or passes a place
criteria.engaged: a formation is engaged with the enemy or attacks
criteria.seen: the enemy comes into sight or approaches
criteria.routs: some body breaks, flees or gives way
criteria.order: a further order from the commander arrives

c0_who.instructions: Read this part of the order: «Everything forward!». If it names such an event, whom does the event concern: which formation must reach or hold the place, be engaged, or break? 'You' is the general this part is given to; 'he' or 'him' is whoever the order last named.

criteria.self: the general or formation this part of the order is given to ('you', 'he', 'it')

c0_where.instructions: Read this part of the order: «Everything forward!». If the event is reaching, taking, holding or passing a place, which place?
